name: AvenuesAI Ltd
title: AvenuesAI Ltd - 539807 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Earnings Call Transcript

read.thesis: Payments-to-AI/lending narrative with no capacity or pricing data; FY26 consolidated revenue INR8,116 cr (+103%) but net revenue only +15% to INR603 cr, and management declined to give FY27 numbers.

triggers.label: Payment gateway margin pressure
triggers.quote: We are in the payment gateway business is somewhat -- there is margin pressure.

triggers.label: No FY27 guidance; no hockey stick
triggers.quote: the profitability, we don't see a hockey stick in FY '27 in profitability.

triggers.label: Platform revenue flat to slightly higher
triggers.quote: the platform business is slightly flat to slightly higher.

guidance.value: similar or slightly higher, to be guided at Q1
guidance.quote: in terms of consolidated basis, we should continue seeing similar numbers or maybe slightly higher

prior_guidance_check.quote: the 30% target for international revenue was made in February 2024. Sir, as of now, also, we are not close to that number.

red_flags.label: Net revenue growth 15% vs gross revenue 103%
red_flags.quote: Our net revenue on a consolidated basis for FY '26 increased 15% year-over-year to INR603 crores

red_flags.label: International revenue target missed
red_flags.quote: as of now, also, we are not close to that number

red_flags.label: XDuce capital deployment unrelated to stated objectives
red_flags.quote: they made one investment in a U.S. cybersecurity firm and the other investment in DEV Information Technologies

red_flags.label: Evasive on AI revenue disclosure
red_flags.quote: We do have specific AI revenue as well, which from a size of the P&L is not material

evasions.quote: We don't participate in the Board of XDuce and we don't allocate the funds.
We do have specific AI revenue as well, which from a size of the P&L is not material
we have certain guidelines and policies that we are not able to share a lot of information about
